proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 E F _ _ _ _ _ _ _ T
  ext y
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, Submodule.mem_orthogonal]
  constructor
  · intro h u hu
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hu
    rw [← LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right, h, inner_zero_right]
  · intro h
    apply ext_inner_left 𝕜
    intro w
    rw [LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right, inner_zero_right]
    exact h _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 E F : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 F] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 F] (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F), LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.adjoint T) = (LinearMap.range T)ᗮ
